Global (All).title: Terrorist Attack in Nigeria
Global (All).summary: Insurgents in Nigeria have carried out a terrorist attack targeting a village in the north-east region, killing dozens of civilians.

Global (All).title: Protests in China
Global (All).summary: Ongoing protests in several cities across China, sparked by growing economic and social discontent, pose significant challenges for the authorities.

Global (All).title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate
Global (All).summary: Increased tensions between the US and Iran have raised concerns about potential military conflicts in the region, impacting global energy markets and trade.

United States.title: US Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene Tests Positive for Covid-19
United States.summary: US representative Marjorie Taylor Greene, who has been vocal about COVID-19 skeptics, has now tested positive for the virus.

United States.title: Gun Laws Bill Passes Key Test in US Senate, Aiding Democrats
United States.summary: The Democrats hope the gun legislation will pass through the US Senate and help curb gun violence in the country.

United States.title: Russian and U.S. Forces Clash Over a Downed Drone in Syria
United States.summary: Russia-U.S. tensions escalate as Russian forces open fire on US troops in Syria after shooting down one of America's drones.

South Korea.title: North Korea launches ballistic missiles and artillery shells across the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ)
South Korea.summary: The launches, which included a Hwasong-12 and short-range ballistic missiles, as well as artillery shells, were seen as a significant escalation of tensions between North and South Korea.

South Korea.title: South Korea's president vows to strengthen national defense against North Korea's nuclear threats
South Korea.summary: President Yoon Suk-yeol's remarks came after North Korea's recent military exercises, which included the launch of a Hwasong-12 ballistic missile.

South Korea.title: South Korean authorities confirm a high-profile hacking case involving a well-known cryptocurrency exchange
South Korea.summary: The incident is believed to have been carried out by a North Korean hacking group, with the hackers making off with millions of dollars in cryptocurrency.
